observations.fact: Type mask and cap/root/none/frame/frameRoot/noCapability modes are format constants.
X options include left/right/center and localLeft/localRight/localCenter aliases.
Y options include front/back/center and local variants.
Z options include top/bottom/center and local variants.
Extent enum names describe leftMost/rightMost/frontMost/backMost/topMost/bottomMost; runtime cardinality and ties are not specified here.
A parent-spine constant and unnamed limb-mask bits exist; writer preserves other bits as selectFlags. Parent-spine author comment explicitly questions another encoding.
Each context is16bytes; capability and numeric ID occupy the same4bytes. Two remaining integer fields are unnamed; bindFlags has separate storage.
Author comment speculates about an index byte in bindFlags. This is not a confirmed limb or body-part index.
Writer emits a secondary numeric ID for masked mode0x100003, distinct from parser numeric-argument mode0x100002; discrepancy retained.

sources.summary: Community format constants and writer labels support spatial selector representation. They do not execute Spore binding, specify same-role match count, or establish random/highest-skill selection.

observations.fact: Parser validates capability strings of at most4characters and recognizes noSelect/root/frame/frameRoot.
Secondary numeric argument stores id; comment calls it external-target index, not body-part index.
selectX/Y/Z, extent, limb and selectFlags options populate bit fields. This is ArgScript parsing, not game execution.

sources.summary: The parser exposes spatial masks and numeric fields. Its representation does not recover the original game selector or its candidate ordering.

selector_format.meaning: Names are decoded using pinned community format constants, not recovered game runtime semantics.

index_interpretation: channel_index indexes this resource channel list. Component index is component metadata. capability_or_id_le_u32 is the same4bytes as the capability string. None is established as a selected body-part index; unnamed field_8/C stay raw.

findings.fact: grsp flags4/8 map to left/right; foot20000/20004 map to localLeft/localRight. strk patterns include Y back20.
No extent-mask bits in1224 sampled contexts; format extent options exist, but these attack/rush clips do not use them.
Untyped selectFlags200000 and other unnamed bits are preserved without assigning single/all/random/highest-skill behavior.
field_8/C are zero across1224 contexts. Zero does not establish match count or selected body node.
The sole non-none secondary field is Patch com_strike_tl_lvl05 L hand, flags0/tagmout, with movementFlags20 lacking the named secondary-enable bit1; actual use remains unknown.
